# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py from trader.ops.config.Settings. -->
<!-- Do not edit by hand: describe the field in config.py and regenerate. -->

Every setting is an environment variable read by `trader.ops.config.Settings` (pydantic-settings, prefix `TRADER_`, names case-insensitive). Values also load from a `.env` file in the working directory; real environment variables outrank it. Copy [`.env.example`](../.env.example) to `.env` to start. Regenerate this page and the example with `uv run python scripts/gen_config_reference.py`; CI runs it with `--check`.

## Categories

- **gate** — fail-closed safety switch. The default is the closed position; flipping it changes what can reach the venue or the decide prompt. Flip through the runbook, one at a time.
- **tuning** — numeric or behavioral parameter; changing it never opens a door by itself.
- **endpoint** — where a dependency lives: a URL, a served model id, or a path.
- **credential** — a secret. Blank means that integration stays off; never commit a value.

Gates at a glance (all default closed):

- `TRADER_AUTH_DISABLED` = `false`
- `TRADER_ALPACA_LIVE_ENABLED` = `false`
- `TRADER_SHADOW_MODE` = `true`
- `TRADER_LOOP_ENABLED` = `false`
- `TRADER_SHADOW_SYMBOLS` = *(empty)*
- `TRADER_BRIEFS_ENABLED` = `false`
- `TRADER_DESK_ENABLED` = `false`
- `TRADER_SENTIMENT_TRIGGER_ENABLED` = `false`

## Surfaces / auth

The API, MCP server and CLI share one service registry; auth guards the first two.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_API_KEY` | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Bearer key the API and MCP surfaces require. Mandatory outside dev: an unset key with `TRADER_AUTH_DISABLED` unset refuses to boot. |
| `TRADER_AUTH_DISABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Explicit dev opt-out from API auth. Without it, an unset `TRADER_API_KEY` fails boot (fail closed). Never set on a reachable box. |
| `TRADER_API_BASE_URL` | `str` | `http://localhost:8080` | endpoint | Where the CLI finds the running API. |

## Store

One Postgres holds everything durable. Market data is never stored (fetch-on-tick).

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_DATABASE_URL` | `str` | `postgresql://trader:trader@localhost:5544/trader` | endpoint | Postgres DSN for the journal, ledger, research store and audit log. The test suite appends `_test` to it and truncates that sibling database. |

## Safety gates

Paper only. The LLM proposes, RiskGuard disposes, the broker executes; no setting bypasses that chain.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_ALPACA_LIVE_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Live Alpaca client construction refuses unless this is `true`. Paper only by default; there is no other path to a live venue. |

## Decide loop

The background scheduler: what it watches, how often, and whether it submits.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_SHADOW_MODE` | `bool` | `true` | gate | Shadow mode defaults ON: the pipeline runs and journals every decision, and submits nothing. Set `false` to let RiskGuard-approved intents reach the paper broker. |
| `TRADER_LOOP_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Runs the background decide loop inside the API process. An explicit operator opt-in; off, the surfaces still serve but nothing ticks. |
| `TRADER_LOOP_TICK_SECONDS` | `float` | `60.0` | tuning | Seconds between scheduler ticks (quote fetch, mark, trigger evaluation). |
| `TRADER_LOOP_SYMBOLS` | `str` | `BTC/USD,ETH/USD` | tuning | Comma-separated symbols the loop watches and may trade. |
| `TRADER_SHADOW_SYMBOLS` | `str` | *(empty)* | gate | Per-symbol shadow: comma-separated tickers that decide and risk-check but never submit, while the rest of the build trades live-paper. A new symbol earns its flip here first. |
| `TRADER_SHADOW_EQUITY` | `float` | `100000.0` | tuning | Equity the risk chain assumes in shadow builds (no broker). Live-paper builds read equity from the broker and keep the last good value when it is down. |

## Risk limits (RiskGuard)

Deterministic limits applied to every intent. Code and config only, never prompt-driven; a change here is a risk-chain behavior change and goes through the decide-change gate.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_RISK_MAX_POSITION_FRAC` | `float` | `0.1` | tuning | Max notional of one position as a fraction of equity. |
| `TRADER_RISK_MIN_NOTIONAL_USD` | `float` | `5.0` | tuning | Opens below this notional are denied (no dust orders), clamps included. |
| `TRADER_RISK_MAX_CONCURRENT_POSITIONS` | `int` | `5` | tuning | Max open positions; a new open beyond it is denied, adds and exits pass. |
| `TRADER_RISK_MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY` | `int` | `20` | tuning | Max submitted trades per UTC day, counted across symbols. |
| `TRADER_RISK_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_FRAC` | `float` | `0.03` | tuning | Daily loss breaker: equity down this fraction from the session start halts opens until an operator resumes it. |
| `TRADER_RISK_WEEKLY_DRAWDOWN_LIMIT_FRAC` | `float` | `0.1` | tuning | Weekly drawdown breaker, same mechanics as the daily limit. |
| `TRADER_RISK_APPROVAL_NOTIONAL_USD` | `float` | `1000.0` | tuning | Unattended opens above this notional clamp down to it and execute; the clamp is journaled. Exits are never clamped. |
| `TRADER_RISK_PARK_ABOVE_USD` | `float` | `0.0` | tuning | `0` disables parking. A value above the approval cap parks larger opens for a human (`trader risk approve`); everything between the cap and this band clamps to the cap and executes unattended. |

## Research Desk

Notes, Macro View compilation, briefs, the decision desk and X sentiment. Every flag here is dark by default and earns its flip through replay, then a shadow window.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_STALE_DAYS` | `int` | `30` | tuning | Days before an unpinned note auto-stales out of compilation (retire stays explicit). |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_COMPILE_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS` | `float` | `30.0` | tuning | Quiet window after the last note change before the Macro View recompiles. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_MIRROR_DIR` | `str` | `research` | tuning | One-way markdown mirror folder (gitignored, regenerable). Empty disables. |
| `TRADER_BRIEFS_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Per-candidate briefs: briefs compile and store on note changes regardless; this flag alone lets them into the decide prompt. A decide-behavior change: flip only through `docs/runbooks/decide-change-gate.md`. |
| `TRADER_DESK_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Decision desk: analyst fan-out + cross-model critic around the decide. Dark by default; earns its flip via replay desk-on vs desk-off, then a shadow window. |
| `TRADER_DESK_CRITIC_DAILY_USD` | `float` | `1.0` | tuning | Critic spend cap per UTC day (the critic prefers Grok, cross-model). At the cap, reviews degrade to journaled pass-throughs. Analysts run on the decide client. |
| `TRADER_SENTIMENT_POLL_SECONDS` | `float` | `10800.0` | tuning | X sentiment poll interval for held symbols; needs an xAI credential (x_search runs server-side on xAI). The daily call cap still bounds a shorter interval. |
| `TRADER_SENTIMENT_DAILY_CALL_CAP` | `int` | `24` | tuning | Max sentiment polls per UTC day across symbols. |
| `TRADER_SENTIMENT_TRIGGER_ENABLED` | `bool` | `false` | gate | Lets a sentiment swing wake the decide loop. Shadow-first: leave OFF until at least a week of journaled scores looks sane. Code default off; a live book arms it in `.env`, never here. |
| `TRADER_SENTIMENT_SWING_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.5` | tuning | Score move between polls that wakes the trader; scores are on [-1, 1]. |
| `TRADER_SENTIMENT_X_HANDLES` | `str` | *(empty)* | tuning | Comma-separated allowlist of X handles for x_search; empty = open search. |

## LLM endpoints

Two roles, each any OpenAI-compatible `/v1`: **decide** (also the desk analysts) and **research** (briefs, compiler, critic, registry sentiment). With `TRADER_DECIDE_BASE_URL` empty, decide uses the **Nemotron preset** (`TRADER_NEMOTRON_*`), whose client forces `chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: false}` on every request; the Spark endpoint collapses to ~0.35 tok/s without it. A generic URL that equals the Nemotron base URL gets the same flag; any other URL never receives `chat_template_kwargs`, because vendor APIs such as OpenAI reject it. Research falls back to xAI when configured, else to the decide client; `x_search` sentiment is xAI-only.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TRADER_NEMOTRON_BASE_URL` | `str` | `http://localhost:8009/v1` | endpoint | Nemotron preset: a self-hosted vLLM `/v1` (default :8009, no auth). Used for decide and analysts when `TRADER_DECIDE_BASE_URL` is empty; the preset client sends `chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: false}` on every request (without it the endpoint collapses to ~0.35 tok/s). A generic URL equal to this one gets the same flag forced on. Inside compose, point it at `http://host.docker.internal:8009/v1`. |
| `TRADER_NEMOTRON_MODEL` | `str` | `nemotron-3-super` | endpoint | Served model id on the Nemotron vLLM. Swapping the decide model on an existing box is a decide-behavior change (`docs/runbooks/decide-change-gate.md`); for a new user it is simply the first run. |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_BASE_URL` | `str` | *(empty)* | endpoint | Any OpenAI-compatible `/v1` for the decide (and analyst) role: OpenAI, Groq, Together, Ollama, vLLM, xAI. Empty selects the Nemotron preset above, which is the only client that sends `chat_template_kwargs`; a vendor API such as OpenAI rejects that argument, so it is never sent to a generic URL. |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | endpoint | Model id at `TRADER_DECIDE_BASE_URL` (ignored under the Nemotron preset). |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_API_KEY` | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Bearer key for `TRADER_DECIDE_BASE_URL`; blank for unauthenticated hosts. |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_EXTRA_BODY` | `str` | *(empty)* | tuning | JSON object merged into every chat-completions body for the decide client (e.g. `{"reasoning_effort": "low"}`). Must parse as an object. |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_PRICE_IN` | `float` | `0.0` | tuning | USD per 1M input tokens for the decide model. `0` reads the built-in PRICES table, else $0 (logged once); non-zero overrides the table. |
| `TRADER_DECIDE_PRICE_OUT` | `float` | `0.0` | tuning | USD per 1M output tokens for the decide model; same rules as the input price. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_BASE_URL` | `str` | *(empty)* | endpoint | Same shape as the decide endpoint, for the brief, compiler, critic and registry sentiment roles. Empty keeps xAI if configured, else the decide client. x_search stays xAI-only. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_MODEL` | `str` | *(empty)* | endpoint | Model id at `TRADER_RESEARCH_BASE_URL`. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_API_KEY` | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Bearer key for `TRADER_RESEARCH_BASE_URL`. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_EXTRA_BODY` | `str` | *(empty)* | tuning | JSON object merged into the research roles' chat-completions bodies. |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_PRICE_IN` | `float` | `0.0` | tuning | USD per 1M input tokens for the research model (`0` = PRICES table, else $0). |
| `TRADER_RESEARCH_PRICE_OUT` | `float` | `0.0` | tuning | USD per 1M output tokens for the research model. |
| `TRADER_XAI_BASE_URL` | `str` | `https://api.x.ai/v1` | endpoint | xAI API base for Grok research roles and x_search sentiment. |
| `TRADER_XAI_MODEL` | `str` | `grok-4` | endpoint | Grok model id for the xAI research roles. |
| `XAI_API_KEY` (alias `TRADER_XAI_API_KEY`) | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | xAI API key: first-class fallback when SuperGrok OAuth is absent or quarantined. Provider-conventional name; the `TRADER_` form is accepted too. |
| `TRADER_XAI_TOKEN_KEY` | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | SuperGrok device-code OAuth: Fernet key that encrypts the token store. Set it, then run `trader xai login`. Generate with `python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"`. Unset, OAuth is disabled and the provider resolves to `XAI_API_KEY` alone. |
| `TRADER_XAI_TOKEN_PATH` | `str` | `~/.config/trader/xai_token.enc` | tuning | Encrypted SuperGrok OAuth token store path. |

## Broker / market data credentials

Provider-conventional names without the prefix are the primary spelling; the `TRADER_`-prefixed alias is accepted too.

| Variable | Type | Default | Category | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALPACA_API_KEY_ID` (alias `TRADER_ALPACA_API_KEY_ID`) | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Alpaca paper key id. The same keys serve broker and market data. Rate-limit budget (Basic/free tier): ~200 req/min across data endpoints; crypto data free; equities = IEX feed only. Fetch-on-tick load is ~2 req/wakeup/symbol, far below budget. |
| `ALPACA_API_SECRET` (alias `TRADER_ALPACA_API_SECRET`) | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Alpaca paper secret, paired with `ALPACA_API_KEY_ID`. |
| `TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY` (alias `TRADER_TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY`) | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | Twelve Data key, equities-quote fallback only (untouched unless Alpaca equities data fails). Free tier: 8 credits/min, 800/day, 1 credit per quote or time_series call. |
| `FRED_API_KEY` (alias `TRADER_FRED_API_KEY`) | `str` | *(empty)* | credential | FRED key (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html) for the macro context line; responses are TTL-cached 1h in-process, so live load is a few calls/day. Absent, the decide prompt carries no FRED line. |
